Headline answer (also in artifacts/hypothesis.txt):

Original papers in Experimental Economics (project=='ee') average 28.00 pages (median 27.5, sd 7.37, n=18 unique originals, 2011-2014). Original papers in Psychology (project=='rpp') average 11.01 pages (median 9.0, sd 6.21, n=88 unique originals, 2008-2015). Within Psychology, Social originals (n=46) average 11.70 pages (median 9.5) and Cognitive originals (n=42) average 10.26 pages (median 8.0); both sub-disciplines remain below the Experimental Economics mean. The ~17-page gap between ee and rpp is robust to two sensitivity checks: including rows with the drop quality flag raises the rpp mean to 11.23 (n=95 unique originals), and using the row-level sample (no de-duplication of repeat replication pairs) gives 11.00 (n rows=90); ee is unchanged across scenarios because no ee row carries the drop flag and no ee original is repeated.

NUMERICAL EVIDENCE
Headline (project-level, drop==False, unique originals):
ee:       n_originals=18, mean=28.00, median=27.5, sd=7.37, min=16, max=45, year 2011-2014
rpp:      n_originals=88, mean=11.01, median=9.0,  sd=6.21, min=1,  max=31, year 2008-2015

Psychology sub-discipline breakdown (drop==False, unique originals):
Social:    n=46, mean=11.70, median=9.5, sd=6.97
Cognitive: n=42, mean=10.26, median=8.0, sd=5.23

Sensitivity (rpp only — ee invariant at 28.00/18 across all rows):
include drop==True, unique originals : n_originals=95, n_rows=97, mean=11.23
row-level no collapse, drop==False   : n_originals=88, n_rows=90, mean=11.00
row-level no collapse, include drops  : n_originals=95, n_rows=97, mean=11.22

Sanity check: length has zero missing values in both ee and rpp; no outliers (max ee=45, max rpp=31 against means 28 and 11).

DELIVERABLES (workspace-relative paths)
- artifacts/analysis.py — executed analysis script
- artifacts/analysis.ipynb — executed notebook (nbformat v4; 7 cells; valid stream outputs)
- artifacts/results.json — machine-readable summary
- artifacts/length_summary.csv — per-segment table
- artifacts/hypothesis.txt — natural-language hypothesis
- artifacts/inspection_plan.py — read-only inspection helper

DECISIONS IMPLEMENTED (researcher-approved)
(a) Primary unit = unique originals (collapse on title+authors.o+journal+pub_year); row-level also reported.
(c) drop==True rows excluded by default; sensitivity row includes them.
(e) Headline = project-level; Plan A discipline breakdown included.
(f) No year window applied; year range reported as descriptive context only.

payload.workflow: Loaded data/meta-regression_study_data_heterogeneity_in_replication_projects.csv (927 rows x 57 cols). Confirmed length is integer pages of original and project encodes the four replication projects. Filtered to project in {ee, rpp}; default excludes drop==True. Collapsed on title+authors.o+journal+pub_year to obtain unique original papers (88 in rpp; 18 in ee). Computed mean/median/std/min/max/IQR for ee and rpp, plus a parallel discipline split for Psychology (Social vs Cognitive). Reported two sensitivities: include drop==True rows, and row-level without de-duplication. Wrote analysis.py, analysis.ipynb (nbformat v4 with executed stream outputs), results.json and length_summary.csv.
